title: Fra gli amplessi in pochi istanti
subtitle: Fiordiligi and Ferrando: duet from Così fan tutte, Act 2 (No. 29)

passages.label: Fra gli amplessi · Oh che gioja · Ed intanto di dolore (Adagio, Con più moto)
Cosa veggio · Con quel ferro di tua mano · Taci, ahimè · Ah che omai la mia costanza (Allegro)
Sorgi, sorgi · Il tuo cor o la mia morte · Cedi, cara
Volgi a me pietoso il ciglio · Giusto ciel · Fa di me quel che ti par (Larghetto)
Abbracciamci, o caro bene (Andante, to the end)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 12, No. 29 Duetto

licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (gioja; quest' abito as two words; Dei without its accent; Fa without an apostrophe; Abbracciamci). The score is followed where it differs from the libretto: Fiordiligi's “in quest' abito verrò” (the libretto has morrò), and Ferrando's “la sua costanza” against Fiordiligi's “la mia costanza” (the libretto gives both “la mia”).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 296–304, bars 1–142 of No. 29
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in three page ranges, pp. 296–298, 299–301 and 302–304), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. Ferrando's part, printed in the treble clef, sounds an octave lower. Adagio in ₵ (alla breve), Con più moto from bar 12, Allegro from bar 24, C major from bar 40, Larghetto in 3/4 and A major from bar 76, Andante in ₵ from bar 101; bars 138–142 are for the piano alone. The cut signs printed at “vi-” (bars 38, 105 and 121) and “-de” (bars 57, 115 and 131) are not written in the score. Playback tempo: Adagio at a half note = 25 (♩ = 50), Con più moto at a half note = 35 (♩ = 70), Allegro at a half note = 75 (♩ = 150), Larghetto at ♩ = 40, Andante at a half note = 60 (♩ = 120), fitted to Jacobs (6:14); Mozart gives the words only.
